rules.author: Chris Brennan
rules.locator: Birthday advancement; examples ages 12,24,36 and age 38 third house
rules.method: From the ascending sign, advance one sign for each completed year; the traditional domicile ruler is lord of the year.
exceptions: Birth-time anniversary versus midnight, leap-day policy and DST ambiguity are explicit software boundary choices, not attributed to the ancient source. Solar-return boundaries are a distinct unimplemented option.

rules.author: Chris Brennan and guests
rules.locator: Annual house and ruler; natal placement and time-lord context
rules.method: Interpret the activated house together with the natal condition of its ruler; keep transits as a separate layer.
exceptions: No strength total or personal-event probability is implied. Whole-sign annual activation remains distinct from quadrant house placements.

scope: Annual whole-sign profections only, not monthly profections or continuous degree profections.
rights: Original concise procedural summaries and factual examples; no book or transcript ingestion.
